summary_en: Introduces Half-Angle-to-Half-Angle (HA2HA), a self-supervised ultrasound microvascular-imaging denoiser that forms noisy training pairs from complementary steering-angle subsets and operates directly on RF blood-flow signals. The method generalizes across contrast-free and contrast-enhanced pig kidney data and human kidney/liver data, improving microvascular visualization while preserving phase information useful for color Doppler processing.

authors: Jingke Zhang; Jingyi Yin; U-Wai Lok; Lijie Huang; Ryan M. DeRuiter; Tao Wu; Kaipeng Ji; Yanzhe Zhao; James D. Krier; Xiang-Yang Zhu; Lilach O. Lerman; Chengwu Huang; Shigao Chen

summary_en: Presents a projection-based processing framework for 3D ultrasound localization microscopy that replaces computationally expensive volumetric steps with efficient 2D operations while preserving reconstruction fidelity. In in-vivo pig-kidney experiments, a 0.75-s, 400-Hz ensemble is reconstructed in 0.52 s on a single GPU, with density-map SSIM of 0.93 relative to conventional 3D processing, enabling faster-than-acquisition feedback.
